name: NLUE
description: NLUE is an expanded Nepali Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark that consolidates and develops datasets covering 12 diverse NLU tasks, including single-sentence classification, similarity, paraphrase, and natural language inference. It aims to provide a comprehensive evaluation suite for Nepali NLP models, addressing limitations of prior benchmarks.
reputation: A useful low-resource Nepali NLP benchmark that consolidates multiple tasks and is increasingly cited for evaluating Nepali language understanding models.
notes: Expands Nepali NLU evaluation from 4 to 12 tasks; highlights challenges for existing models on complex NLU tasks.
